title: What Bio-Concrete Systems Is
definition: Bio-Concrete Systems: concrete grown by biological processes.
description:
Bio-Concrete Systems — Signature Edition: concrete grown by biological processes. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature system hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: ureolytic bacteria rethought, system logistics rebuilt, calcium sources reimagined for the century ahead. This edition mirrors the public database record for record — concept, components, milestones, demos, drills, alliance, roadmap — but every entry is the Signature take: bolder timelines, integrated systems thinking, and the cure times ambition that defines the Signature line.

definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Bio-Concrete Systems.

The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Bio-Concrete Systems becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Bio-Concrete Systems
definition: Estimates Bio-Concrete Systems readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Bio-Concrete Systems components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a system hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Bio-Concrete Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Bio-Concrete Systems operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Bio-Concrete Systems installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 91103 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where ureolytic bacteria monitoring, system logistics redundancy, or calcium sources maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Bio-Concrete Systems Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Bio-Concrete Systems: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Bio-Concrete Systems — concrete grown by biological processes.

Phase 1 — Prove (ureolytic bacteria): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (system logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (calcium sources): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cure times): system hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
